Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ONE transparent 2D paper-puppet hand sprite for the Human1 LEFT hand.
Input image 1 is the edit target and material/style reference. Preserve its ivory handmade-paper fibers, warm ochre circular wrist plate, circular wrist attachment hole, thin brown cut-paper edges and restrained dimensional shading.
Create the OPEN PALM / FRONT state: anatomical left palm toward viewer, wrist at top, fingers pointing down, thumb on image RIGHT. Five fingers total (four relaxed slightly separated fingers and one thumb), broad visible palm with very subtle cut-paper palm folds. No nails on palm face. Preserve the source character's simple paper-doll proportions.
Output: exactly ONE isolated hand, square 1024x1024 RGBA canvas with genuine transparency. Whole hand and wrist connector visible, 60px clear margins.
